run_submission_cli: run the CLI script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from results
write_is2re_relaxations_from_traj: write IS2RE relaxation predictions from .traj trajectory files in a directory to a compressed NPZ submission file
write_is2re_relaxations_hybrid: write IS2RE predictions from hybrid S2EF NPZ prediction files combining force and energy models
write_predictions_from_npz: write S2EF or IS2RE predictions from an NPZ results file to a challenge submission NPZ file with challenge_ prefixed keys
review_main_entry: review the main entry point that routes between write_predictions and write_is2re_relaxations based on CLI flags
